name: ping keeps working
why: ping must still answer ready, adapter is not changed

name: dsu n=0
why: no operations so no states, largest is 0 here

name: dsu single vertex self union
why: union of vertex with itself does nothing, still 1 component with size 1

name: dsu pairs then bridge
why: 0-1 gives 4 comps, 2-3 gives 3 comps, then 1-3 joins both into size 4 so 2 comps. 3-0 is repeat and 4-4 is self union, nothing changes

name: dsu rank is not size
why: set {2,3,4} has size 3, after joining {0,1} size is 5. if we use rank as size it would say 2, which is wrong

name: kruskal loop only
why: loop never connects two components even if weight is negative

name: prim loop only
why: loop never connects two components even if weight is negative

name: kruskal parallel negative ties
why: edges 1,2,3 all have -3 and make triangle, any two of them is optimal (cost -6). edge 0 is heavier parallel edge and edge 4 is loop

name: prim parallel negative ties
why: edges 1,2,3 all have -3 and make triangle, any two of them is optimal (cost -6). edge 0 is heavier parallel edge and edge 4 is loop

name: kruskal sum above 32 bits
why: need 2 of 3 equal edges, 2000000000 is bigger than 2^31-1

name: prim sum above 32 bits
why: need 2 of 3 equal edges, 2000000000 is bigger than 2^31-1

name: kruskal negative sum below 32 bits
why: path is already a tree, -3000000000 is smaller than -2^31

name: prim negative sum below 32 bits
why: path is already a tree, -3000000000 is smaller than -2^31

name: kruskal forest with isolate
why: in {0,1,2} we take edge 2 (w=1) and one edge with w=2, so 3. {3,4} only edge 3 = 7. vertex 5 alone. total 10, 3 components and 6-3 = 3 edges

name: prim forest with isolate
why: in {0,1,2} we take edge 2 (w=1) and one edge with w=2, so 3. {3,4} only edge 3 = 7. vertex 5 alone. total 10, 3 components and 6-3 = 3 edges

name: kruskal prim restart order
why: vertex 0 is isolated so Prim has to restart at 1 and then at 3. for {1,2} lighter parallel edge 2 (w=4) is used, for {3,4} edge 0

name: prim prim restart order
why: vertex 0 is isolated so Prim has to restart at 1 and then at 3. for {1,2} lighter parallel edge 2 (w=4) is used, for {3,4} edge 0

name: scc n=1 loop
why: with loop the vertex is still one SCC, no pairs between different SCCs

name: scc two cycles joined both ways
why: 0<->1 and 2<->3, also 1->2 and 3->0, so every vertex reach every other one. one SCC

name: scc duplicate cross edges
why: {0,1,2} is cycle, 3 (has loop) and 4 are single SCCs. 2->3 and 1->3 give same pair only once, 4->3 is second pair

name: scc chain of cycles
why: three 2-cycles A={0,1} B={2,3} C={4,5}, edges A->B, B->C and shortcut A->C. nothing goes back so they stay separate

name: topo diamond
why: 0 first and 3 last, 1 and 2 can be in any order

name: topo forward edge is not a cycle
why: DFS from 0 finishes 2 through 1, after that 0->2 goes to DONE vertex. this is forward edge, not cycle. order is unique here

name: topo cross edge between trees
why: DFS from 0 finishes it first, later trees from 1 and 2 go into DONE vertex 0 (cross edge). any order with 0 last is ok

name: topo cycle away from start
why: 3->4->3 is cycle in second component, so whole graph can not be ordered

name: topo n=0
why: empty graph is acyclic and order is empty

name: dag better path found later
why: 0->1 directly costs 5, but 0->2->1 is 2-10 = -8, so parent of 1 is edge 2. then 3 is -8+1 = -7 by edge 3

name: dag source after unreachable vertices
why: 0 and 1 are before source and can not be reached from it, they stay null and -1 and we dont relax from them

name: dag distance minus one is a real distance
why: vertex 1 is reachable with cost -1. vertex 2 is unreachable so it must be null, not -1

name: dag cycle unreachable from source
why: 2->3->4->2 is cycle, source cant reach it but whole graph must be acyclic anyway

name: dag loop
why: loop is directed cycle too

name: dag tied paths and parallel edges
why: four ways reach 3 with cost 3 (via 1, via 2 and two parallel direct edges 4 and 5). any of edges 2,3,4,5 is ok as parent of 3
